objective: Advance twelve high-scale Federation opportunities in phases until each reaches its highest supportable production, provider, value, or explicitly-held state without allowing one blocked lane to freeze unrelated work.

phases.name: Independent challenge and programme admission
exit_gates: fresh Gemini sanitized scale audit with provider-native receipt
CFBE-Omega challenge court defined
all twelve initiatives registered with dependencies and authority ceilings
no unsupported production or live-effect claims

phases.name: Federation evaluation and proof substrate
exit_gates: universal CFBE evaluation contract
ProofOS evidence/maturity binding
live capability graph with source/runtime/provider/value states
deterministic benchmark receipts

phases.name: Evolution, routing and failure intelligence
exit_gates: challenger generation under bounded experiment court
multi-model selection by evidence/cost/latency/risk
failure genome feeds regression and recovery
no unbounded self-modification

phases.name: Flagship domain foundries
exit_gates: Omega-Max capital research foundry reaches paper/shadow qualification before any live-capital gate
CIOS reaches provider/runtime qualification and demonstrable value proof
SOVARA Creative reaches provider/runtime qualification and commercial value proof

phases.name: Enterprise control, opportunity and product factory
exit_gates: Opportunity Radar produces proof-scored build candidates
enterprise AI control plane is provider-verified on admitted surfaces
vertical product factory produces at least one end-to-end acceptance-to-renewal system with measured value

phases.name: Production convergence and externalization
exit_gates: security/privacy/observability/rollback/readback complete per deployed service
provider-native deployment proof complete for each released surface
value telemetry distinguishes modeled, synthetic, pilot and real outcomes
Federation-as-a-Service APIs expose only Ledger-approved capabilities
financial live effects remain held unless separately explicitly authorized
